independent.summary: activeSuggestion is never reset when the tags input loses focus (@blur only clears tagsFocused), so leaving the field with an arrow-key-highlighted option and returning to it reopens the list with that stale option still active and aria-activedescendant pointing at it; a subsequent Enter inserts a tag the user never re-selected.

summary: The local model reported nothing, which is close to right — the change is well-formed (tests and build verified green here, /tags is proxied and workspace-scoped, Vue 3.5.32 supports useId) — but it missed the one real, if minor, state-reset bug on blur.
